chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from someone else, from Yunus, from Ali ibn Yaqteen, from Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Sunnah regarding carrying the funeral coffin is that you face the side of the bier with your right side, so the left side adheres to your right shoulder. Then you pass over it to the other side, and turn from behind it to the third side of the bier. Then you pass over it to the fourth side, which is on your left.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended method for carrying a funeral coffin according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) specifies the precise physical methodology for carrying the bier, instructing carriers to move in an anticlockwise direction around the coffin to ensure dignity and ease of transport. It highlights the Shia emphasis on detailed ritual etiquette (adab) in funeral rites, ensuring that the deceased is honored through orderly and respectful physical handling. This ruling is transmitted through a strong chain of narrators including Yunus ibn Abi al-Akhdar, reflecting the scholarly rigor of al-Kafi.
